mechanism: Diclofenac may increase fluid retention and cardiovascular effects potentiated by testosterone's androgenic and anabolic properties, while testosterone may inhibit renal prostaglandin synthesis via diclofenac, increasing sodium/fluid retention and hypertension risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure, fluid status, and renal function periodically; consider alternative analgesics if cardiovascular or renal disease present; ensure adequate dosing intervals between medications.
